newsitem.title: JAPAN: MOF to auction 10-yr, 2-yr JGBs next week--traders.
newsitem.headline: MOF to auction 10-yr, 2-yr JGBs next week--traders.

text.p: The Finance Ministry is likely to offer 10-year Japanese government bonds and two-year government notes through price-competitive auctions next week, traders said on Friday.
MOF is expected to hold an auction for 10-year JGBs next Wednesday, and hold another for two-year government notes next Friday, they said.

Judging from current market conditions, the coupon rate for the new 10-year issue is likely to be set at either 2.4 percent or 2.5 percent, down from 2.6 percent for the latest 197th 10-year JGB which MOF offered through an auction in June, traders said.
